Package index

Research workflows & apps

Run scripted STORM, hold an interactive Co-STORM session, or launch a research app.

tempest_run()
Run the STORM pipeline
tempest_session()
Create a Co-STORM session
tempest_researcher()
Research a topic and produce an enriched report
tempest_researcher_app()
Launch the enriched research application
tempest_app()
Run the Tempest research application
tempest_config()
Create a STORM configuration
tempest_expert() experimental
Create a Tempest expert profile

Inspect reports & evidence

Read committed reports, verify claim-by-span support, inspect scientific reviews, or share an MCP card.

tempest_report()
Read the committed Markdown report from a Tempest product
tempest_sources()
Return evidence resources as a tibble
tempest_claims()
Return claims as a tibble
tempest_claim_supports()
List explicit claim-support assessments
tempest_claim_reviews()
Read scientific claim reviews
tempest_trajectory_review() experimental
A bounded review of one completed Tempest product
tempest_trajectory_review_data()
Extract a validated trajectory review projection
tempest_mcp_app() experimental
Review a completed research product in an MCP App

Enriched research reports

Pair cited research with reproducible R analyses, illustrations, and integrity-checked bundles.

tempest_enrich_report()
Enrich completed research with computations and illustrations
tempest_read_enriched_report()
Read and verify a portable enriched report
tempest_r_executor()
Create a Deputy-backed R execution callback
tempest_image_generator()
Create an OpenAI image generation callback

Reviewed memory with Graft

Publish candidates, review and accept findings in Graft, and admit verified evidence into later runs.

tempest_publish_artifact_research()
Preserve completed research in a Graft artifact store
tempest_read_artifact_research()
Inspect retained research without admitting it to execution
tempest_reuse_artifact_research()
Admit a current accepted research decision
tempest_artifact_knowledge()
Bring a retained artifact selection into a research run
tempest_promotion_bundle()
Build a deterministic proposal for reviewed Graft promotion
tempest_save_promotion_bundle()
Save a Tempest promotion bundle atomically
tempest_read_promotion_bundle()
Read and validate a current Tempest promotion bundle
print(<tempest_knowledge>)
Print accepted organizational knowledge

Persistence & host retrievers

Save and resume Co-STORM sessions or connect custom host retrievers and source records.

tempest_session_save() experimental
Save a Co-STORM session bundle
tempest_session_resume()
Resume a saved Co-STORM session bundle
tempest_research_workspace()
Create a provisional research workspace
tempest_resource() experimental
Create a typed evidence resource
tempest_source_id()
Create a deterministic source ID from a URL
